detailed_description: Free 2026 World Cup simulator. Run 10k Monte Carlo simulations with Elo ratings, custom host/heritage sliders, and sleek gold ECharts. 100% offline.
usage_steps: Adjust the Home Advantage, Heritage DNA, and Wildcard Chaos sliders on the left panel
Select two focus teams from the dropdowns to compare their head-to-head odds
Click the golden button to launch 10,000 Monte Carlo tournament simulations
Review the Champion Probability bar chart, Radar comparison, and advancement funnel on the right
usage_examples: Crank up the Chaos slider to see dark horse teams like Japan or Morocco surge in win probability
Maximize Home Advantage to forecast USA, Mexico, and Canada's best advancement paths
Compare Argentina vs Brazil championship odds in a simulated final showdown

faqs.question: How does the simulation model work?
faqs.answer: The simulator uses real FIFA/Elo ratings for all 48 teams, computing win/draw/loss via a Logistic probability equation (with a 26% baseline draw rate) and Poisson-distributed goals for tie-breaker rankings.

faqs.question: How does it replicate the 2026 expanded format?
faqs.answer: It fully models 48 teams in 12 groups. The top 2 from each group advance directly, and the best 8 of 12 third-placed teams also qualify for a 32-team knockout bracket.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded anywhere?
faqs.answer: Never. The entire Monte Carlo engine and ECharts rendering run locally in your browser with zero server communication.
